title.value: Review landing page copy for legal disclosure issues

introduction.value: An in-house lawyer uses a review agent to inspect new landing page copy and flag disclosure issues before it reaches them, alongside other drafting and research tools.

method.value: The Reddit post is an in-house lawyer’s roundup of AI tools they already use for drafting, review, and research, plus a note that they want help checking marketing materials such as landing pages for consumer-protection compliance. The specific landing-page review agent appears only in a comment, which suggests a custom AI agent trained on ROSCA and related rules that marketing would submit copy to before legal review, so it could flag issues like negative-option language or unclear disclosures.

outcome.value: The thread gives no evidence that this review agent was actually built or used, and it reports no results, accuracy figures, or workflow metrics for it. What it does show is demand for that kind of pre-screening alongside the poster’s existing legal AI stack.

notes.value: This use case is only a suggestion in the comments, not a documented implementation, so the thread offers no concrete build steps, costs, or performance data.

Act as a legal reviewer for marketing copy.
